questions.question: Given String a = new String("red") and String b = new String("red"), which expression tests their text content?
questions.explanation: String.equals compares text. Reference identity and matching lengths do not establish equal content.

questions.question: Which standard implementation provides a mutable, indexed list with duplicates?
questions.explanation: ArrayList implements List and supports positional access and duplicate elements.

questions.question: What does a HashMap do when put is called with a key that already has a mapping?

options.b: Keep both values under that key
options.c: Delete the key and ignore the new value
options.d: Throw an exception for any duplicate key

questions.explanation: A map associates a key with one value, so put replaces its previous mapping.

questions.question: Which exception is checked in Java?
questions.explanation: IOException must be caught or declared when it can escape a method.

questions.question: Which types can be used as resources in a Java try-with-resources declaration? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: BufferedReader and Connection implement AutoCloseable.

questions.question: Shape shape = new Circle(); Circle overrides the public instance method draw. Which draw implementation runs on shape.draw()?

options.a: Shape.draw because Shape is the variable's declared type
options.b: Circle.draw because Circle is the runtime type
options.c: Both methods automatically run in that order
options.d: A compile-time overload picks the return type

questions.explanation: Instance-method dispatch uses the runtime type to select an override.

questions.question: A function should read Number values from either List<Integer> or List<Double>. Which parameter type fits?
questions.explanation: The upper-bounded wildcard permits lists whose element types extend Number.

questions.question: In Java 17, what is the result of List.of(1, 2, 3, 4).stream().filter(n -> n % 2 == 0).map(n -> n + 1).toList()?
questions.explanation: The filter keeps 2 and 4. The map adds 1 to each.

questions.question: Which Stream method is terminal?
questions.explanation: count consumes the stream and returns the number of elements.

questions.question: Which statements matter for an object used as a HashMap key? Select all that apply.

options.a: Two objects that are equal must have the same hashCode
options.b: Unequal objects are required to have different hashCode values
options.c: Changing fields used for equality while the key is stored can break lookup
options.d: A key's hashCode must be the object's memory address

questions.explanation: Equality and hashing must agree, and changing either can invalidate lookup of a stored key.

questions.question: Given final List<String> tags = new ArrayList<>(), what does final prevent?

options.c: Removing an item from the list

questions.explanation: final fixes the variable binding. It does not make the referenced list immutable.

questions.question: What is the result of 11 / 4 when both Java operands are int?
questions.explanation: Integer division truncates toward zero and returns an integer.

questions.question: Which return type represents a lookup that may yield one Order or no result?
questions.explanation: Optional represents one present value or an empty result.

questions.question: Which call atomically adds one to a shared AtomicInteger counter and returns the new value?
questions.explanation: incrementAndGet performs the read-modify-write as a single atomic operation.

questions.question: Which methods are valid in a Java interface when declared as shown? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: Interfaces support abstract declarations and default methods with bodies.

questions.question: Which Java collection interface models adding and removing elements at both ends?
questions.explanation: Deque represents a double-ended queue.

questions.question: A record named Point declares components int x and int y. Which method reads its x component?
questions.explanation: The compiler supplies an instance accessor named after the record component.

questions.question: Which String method checks whether text starts with the prefix 'api/'?
questions.explanation: startsWith tests the prefix at the start of the string.

questions.question: A Java array contains exactly three values. What is the last valid index?
questions.explanation: Array indexes begin at zero, so the last index is length minus one.

questions.question: Which actions are valid for an ArrayList<String> named names? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: ArrayList<String> accepts strings and supports isEmpty. put belongs to map types.
